candidate_family: methane hydrogen-deuterium exchange with Bronsted acid zeolites
net_event: CH4 plus deuterated Bronsted zeolite acid site <-> partially deuterated methane plus protonated zeolite site
classification_basis: The observed chemical event is hydrogen/deuterium exchange between methane and a zeolitic Bronsted site and is physically distinct from the frozen gas-phase H3 exchange family. The isotopic label is the experimental tracer of a different substrate/catalyst family, not an isotopologue replicate of the frozen H3 family.

primary_experiment.authors: Bart Schoofs, Johan A. Martens, Pierre A. Jacobs, Robert A. Schoonheydt
primary_experiment.title: Kinetics of Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Reactions of Methane and Deuterated Acid FAU- and MFI-Type Zeolites
primary_experiment.measurement: recirculation batch reactor with online mass-spectrometric methane-isotopomer analysis
primary_experiment.activation_energy_quarantine: The tabulated apparent activation energies are derived from the measured rate-temperature series and cannot independently validate those same rates.

theory_source.authors: Ann M. Vos, Frank De Proft, Robert A. Schoonheydt, Paul Geerlings
theory_source.title: Calculation of reaction rate constants for hydrogen-deuterium exchange reactions of methane catalysed by acid zeolites

calculated_rate_record.role: theoretical output only, not the independent observed comparator

theory_source.model_composition_note: The three-T-atom cluster has Si/Al=2, whereas the primary experiments span discrete MFI and FAU samples with different Si/Al ratios. The theory paper itself notes structural, long-range, and composition limitations of the cluster approximation.
theory_source.target_fit_audit: No explicit fitting of electronic-structure parameters to the target rate was identified, but the paper is explicitly a validation comparison against the pre-existing 1999 kinetics, so agreement cannot be used post hoc to alter method, cluster, or corrections.

mechanism_audit.theoretical_representation: single symmetric concerted hydrogen-exchange transition state
mechanism_audit.experimental_result: The 1999 experiment measured kH/kD about 1.6-1.7 and stated that this disagrees with the earlier concerted-reaction interpretation, suggesting O-D/O-H bond dissociation as rate-determining or a non-concerted mechanism.
mechanism_audit.theory_self_check: The 2001 calculation gives k_OH/CD divided by k_OD/CH approximately 1.02 and explicitly notes that the experimental isotope effect is larger than the theoretical value.

next_gate: Recover a primary text/table numerical raw exchange-rate value for a fully specified zeolite composition and state point, then identify an independently specified barrier model for that same composition whose elementary mechanism is compatible with the measured isotope-effect evidence. Do not use rate-derived activation energies or figure-extracted rates to close the comparator gate.
